cases.title: Toggle Text Box Visibility
cases.description: Verify that clicking the toggle button (data-testid="toggle-button") correctly shows and hides the text box (data-testid="text-box") by adding or removing the 'show' class, starting from an initially hidden state.

cases.title: Close Text Box via Close Button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Close' button (data-testid="close-button") inside the visible text box hides the text box by removing the 'show' class.

cases.title: Populate Voice Dropdown on Open
cases.description: Verify that opening the text box populates the voice dropdown (data-testid="voice-select") with available voices from the Web Speech API and handles 'voiceschanged' events.

cases.title: Select Voice and Handle Multiple Selections
cases.description: Verify that selecting a voice from the dropdown updates the active voice for speech synthesis, correctly handling multiple selections and specific language codes.

cases.title: Read Text from Textarea
cases.description: Verify that entering text into the textarea (data-testid="text-area") and clicking the 'Read Text' button (data-testid="read-button") triggers speech synthesis using the selected voice.

cases.title: Predefined Phrase Box Interaction and Highlighting
cases.description: Verify that clicking a dynamically generated phrase box triggers text-to-speech playback and applies the 'active' highlight class for 800 milliseconds across normal, sequential, and rapid click scenarios.

opinions.feedback: All proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, cover all requirements completely, and present no blockers.
All cases and requirements are consistent and fully testable without any blockers.

analysis.analysis: e2edev_bench_04-R-1: Testable behavior: Toggle text box visibility using 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid="toggle-button"). Boundaries: Initial state is hidden. Normal/Abnormal paths: Single clicks, rapid repeated clicks. Ambiguities: Exact timing for rapid clicks not specified. e2edev_bench_04-R-2: Testable behavior: Hide text box using 'Close' button (data-testid="close-button") and show via toggle button. Boundaries: Visibility controlled by 'show' class. Normal/Abnormal paths: Open then close sequence. e2edev_bench_04-R-3: Testable behavior: Populate voice dropdown (data-testid="voice-select") via Web Speech API upon opening text box. Boundaries: Listens to 'voiceschanged' event. Normal/Abnormal paths: Empty voice lists, dynamic updates. e2edev_bench_04-R-4: Testable behavior: Select voice from dropdown and assign to speech synthesis. Boundaries: Voice options with language codes ('CN', 'US'). Normal/Abnormal paths: Multiple selections, ensuring last selected voice is active. e2edev_bench_04-R-5: Testable behavior: Enter text into textarea (data-testid="text-area") and read aloud via 'Read Text' button (data-testid="read-button"). Normal/Abnormal paths: Empty text, various voices. e2edev_bench_04-R-6: Testable behavior: Generate predefined phrase boxes, click to read text aloud and highlight with 'active' class for 800ms. Normal/Abnormal paths: Normal clicks, sequential clicks, rapid repeated clicks.
